summary: {member} asks whether the organization being counted on for nominees was ever contacted.
realLife: Bergman said the Hearing Loss Association had received no outreach. Mossberg offered to have the department send a letter to a named organization.
inGame: needs: the outreach log and a named association.

turns.pulledBy: The group names a person to receive the request.
turns.what: Staff address the invitation to that person.
turns.writesBack: The association can circulate the qualifications.

turns.pulledBy: A prior letter has already been delivered.
turns.what: The chair asks what followed it.
turns.writesBack: The next inquiry goes to the recipient.
